description:
HushGram v0.0.4 targets Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (com.instagram.android) with 46 patches, eleven more than the last release. The new ones keep Instagram's auto scroll and a seek bar in Reels, stop Reels scrolling, hide highlights and suggested people on profiles, loop stories, show a story's exact time and copy or save from comments. Every new patch is off until you pick it in Manager.

Read Before you sign in in the README first. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do. Sign in with a spare account if you can, and don't clear the app's data afterward.

Validation: 1290 runtime tests passed locally. All 519 patch tests passed too. All 46 patches applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, version code 385511871. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
